mapper.select:
SELECT W.STOCK_SEQ, W.STOCK_CODE, W.STOCK_GROUP, W.STOCK_GROUP_DIV, W.STOCK_CLOSE, S.STOCK_KO_NAME, S.STOCK_EN_NAME, S.STOCK_MARKET, S.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE FROM TB_S_INTEREST_WATCHLIST W LEFT JOIN TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK S ON W.STOCK_CODE = S.STOCK_CODE WHERE 1=1
AND W.STOCK_GROUP = #{groupId}
AND ( (#{market} = 'N' AND S.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE = 'KR') OR (#{market} = 'A' AND S.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE != 'KR') OR W.STOCK_GROUP_DIV = #{market} )
ORDER BY W.STOCK_SEQ ASC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TB_S_INTEREST_WATCHLIST T USING ( SELECT #{groupId} AS STOCK_GROUP, #{stockCode} AS STOCK_CODE, #{stockClose} AS STOCK_CLOSE FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.STOCK_GROUP = S.STOCK_GROUP AND T.STOCK_CODE = S.STOCK_CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE, T.STOCK_CLOSE = NVL(S.STOCK_CLOSE, T.STOCK_CLOSE), T.STOCK_GROUP_DIV = NVL(T.STOCK_GROUP_DIV, 'normal') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( STOCK_SEQ, STOCK_CODE, STOCK_GROUP, STOCK_GROUP_DIV, STOCK_CLOSE, STOCK_30MIN_SMA_LINES, STOCK_SMA_LINES, MODIFY_DATE, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(STOCK_SEQ), 0) + 1 FROM TB_S_INTEREST_WATCHLIST), S.STOCK_CODE, S.STOCK_GROUP, 'normal', S.STOCK_CLOSE, NULL, NULL, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
